features.title: Built for Local Businesses
features.subtitle: Everything you need to automate your front desk and manage your queue without any technical expertise.
features.f1Desc: Your patient can text your clinic 24/7. Our Hinglish AI understands them naturally and books slots automatically.
features.f2Desc: The moment an appointment is booked on WhatsApp, it appears instantly on the receptionist dashboard.
features.f3Desc: Built on PostgreSQL with strict unique constraints. Two patients can never book the same slot at the exact same time.
features.f4Desc: Access your clinic queue from anywhere. Simple, flat, and extremely fast web interface built for speed.

domains.t3Desc: Answer curriculum FAQs automatically and schedule trial classes or counseling sessions with administrators.
domains.t4Desc: Schedule global buyer meetings across different time zones effortlessly via WhatsApp AI.
